author: LachezarVoynov
seen: A 1:57 fully AI-generated vertical ad. A blonde presenter in a pink tank top time-travels through the history of hair-loss treatment, talking to camera like a travel vlogger. 0:07 an ancient Chinese apothecary (on-screen "3,000 years of hair loss treatment"), where an herbalist explains blood flow to the scalp; 0:36 a village in India grinding turmeric for the scalp; 0:51 "two completely separate civilizations… both landing on the exact same principles". 1:06 a "1974, industrial haircare factory, New Jersey" title card: a manager says "we produce 50,000 units a day… maybe 1% actives, consumers can't tell the difference". The presenter turns to camera: "they gave you 1% and charged you for 10", and only then is the product introduced. Word-by-word yellow captions throughout. The agency calls it "a direct-response VSL disguised as a founder story" and says it spends $10K a month on AI video tools.
